points.quote: A document is a Yjs CRDT (`Y.Doc`). BlockSuite models blocks as Y.Maps and Y.Arrays inside it ... each page is its own sub-doc.
An edit mutates the Y.Doc in the editor. ... it calls `applyUpdate(doc, bin, NBSTORE_ORIGIN)` on the live Y.Doc, and the editor re-renders from that.
Storage and sync treat a doc as binary Yjs update blobs, not as structured rows.
Web: IndexedDB (`impls/idb`). ... Desktop and mobile: a native SQLite database (`impls/sqlite`...).
A remote update goes into local storage first. ... For cloud workspaces, `impls/cloud/doc.ts` talks to the NestJS server over socket.io.
